summary: Regression testing after api.js getToken()/getRefreshToken() were wrapped with withTimeout(Preferences.get(), 1200, {value:null}) with localStorage fallback. Change is guarded by isNative(); web path reads localStorage directly. Verified backend (14/14 pytest) and web frontend end-to-end: admin login -> /feed in 0.37s, /admin loads, /settings logout clears both access + refresh tokens and returns to '/', bob login -> /feed in 0.37s, registration flow already covered by backend test_register_new_user. Token refresh via body verified (test_refresh_via_body). No runtime-error overlay, no pageerrors, only the pre-existing <span>-in-<option> hydration warning on /admin.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside reports-category select (Admin.jsx line 365). Unchanged from iter 6.

critical_code_review_comments: api.js withTimeout implementation is correct: Promise.race with a fallback resolver ensures no unhandled rejection and never blocks longer than 1200ms. Rejection path also mapped to fallback via .catch(). Good.

primeTokenCache only marks _tokenLoaded=true when a token is actually retrieved (line 101). This is deliberate but means every unauthenticated API call re-invokes getToken() -> localStorage lookup (cheap on web, ~1200ms worst-case on cold-boot native). Acceptable.
getToken() is exported but getRefreshToken() is not — used only internally by performRefresh(). Fine.
Pre-existing: sidebar still lacks an 'Admin' entry for role==='admin' — only accessible via direct /admin URL. UX enhancement suggestion carried over from iter 6.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_user_<uid>@clanchat.app created via backend register test (not auto-cleaned).
context_for_next_testing_agent: api.js native token read now bounded by 1200ms timeout with localStorage fallback. Web path unchanged (localStorage). Native Android APK path NOT exercisable in browser (Capacitor.isNativePlatform() is false on web). Preview URL: https://clan-chat-fix.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca of the issue: Original spinner bug: on cold Android WebView, Capacitor Preferences.get() bridge could hang; request interceptor awaited getToken() before every request, so login POST was never dispatched. Fix races the plugin call against a 1200ms timeout and falls back to localStorage (dual-written by setToken/rememberToken). Web is unaffected because isNative() is false and the code reads localStorage directly. Regression suite confirms zero web impact.
